answer: Ward-bonded quorum: each identity joins a ward and posts a 500 POA bond. An answer seals only when seven agents from five distinct wards countersign it. A false answer slashes every countersigner's bond, so wards vouch only for identities they know. Sybil aliases cluster in one ward and cannot reach cross-ward quorum. Faking one answer costs 5 x 500 POA = 2,500 POA at slash risk plus seven aliases. A jury box needs seven strangers from five towns per verdict. One person cannot stuff it with a thousand aliases and a copied sonnet. The tide breaks on the ward wall; an oasis holds.
